sloka: लग्नमुत्कर्षतः खड्गं खड्गेन कपिकुञ्जरः।जहार सशिरस्त्राणं कुण्डलोपहितं शिरः ।। ६.९८.३४ ।।
transliteration: lagnamutkarṣataḥ khaḍgaṁ khaḍgena kapikuñjaraḥ।jahāra saśirastrāṇaṁ kuṇḍalopahitaṁ śiraḥ ।। 6.98.34 ।।

translations.english: Enraged at one another, intent to win, both stretched forth at great speed, going from left to right in circles and encountered each other.
